questions.question: How many contract actions on N00024-09-C-2116 fall in fiscal year 2015, and what did they obligate in total?
questions.verify_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, CAST(SUM(CAST(federal_action_obligation AS DECIMAL(20,2))) AS STRING) AS total FROM {schema}.aircarrier_src_2116_contract_transactions WHERE year(to_date(action_date)) + CASE WHEN month(to_date(action_date)) >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 2015

questions.question: How many contract actions on the Kennedy detail design and construction contract N00024-15-C-2114 fall in fiscal year 2018, and what did they obligate in total?

questions.question: What is the single largest obligation action on N00024-09-C-2116: which modification, what amount, and on what date?
